about: Reviewed crawl misreads that the company-master contact merge must not insert as contacts: page headings read as names, board lists whose sector line was lost, members listed with their own employers' titles, and a national body's people read again on a regional office that shares its website. Applied by scripts/master/screen_profile_people.py between build_contact_profiles.py and merge_master_contacts.py. name '*' screens every crawled or browser-read person of the organisation (a search agent's confirmed record is kept). The raw crawl file is kept as evidence.
